title: Sub-Meter Canopy Height Synthesis from Sentinel-2 via Anchored Residual Flow
abstract: arXiv:2611.22636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Canopy height models (CHMs) - per-pixel maps of vegetation top height - are essential for forest carbon accounting, wildfire fuel mapping, and tree-level ecology, yet sub-meter CHMs require airborne LiDAR refreshed on multi-year national cycles. We produce 0.5 m CHMs from free 10 m Sentinel-2 imagery, a 20$\times$ cross-modal super-resolution task where optical reflectance must predict geometric height it does not directly observe. Motivated by the perception-distortion trade-off, we derive two operating points with shared conditioning. A deterministic regressor (Anchor) targets low distortion; a conditional flow matching model, trained on the Anchor's residual in a learned CHM latent space (AR-flow), targets perceptual fidelity. Trained on 197k LiDAR-paired tiles spanning 69 ecoregions across the contiguous United States and evaluated on 2,530 held-out tiles against eight baselines, the Anchor achieves 2.83 m MAE using only free satel

translated_title: 基于锚定残差流的Sentinel-2亚米级冠层高度合成
translated_abstract: 冠层高度模型（CHMs）——即植被顶部高度的逐像素地图——对森林碳核算、野火燃料制图以及树木级生态学研究至关重要，然而亚米级CHM依赖需按国家多年周期更新的机载激光雷达（LiDAR）。本研究从免费的10米Sentinel-2影像生成0.5米分辨率的CHM，这是一项20倍的跨模态超分辨率任务，需要光学反射率预测其无法直接观测的几何高度。受感知-失真权衡的启发，我们推导出两个共享条件化的工作点：一个确定性回归器（Anchor）以低失真为目标；一个条件流匹配模型，在学习到的CHM潜空间中基于Anchor的残差进行训练（AR-flow），以感知保真度为目标。模型在横跨美国本土69个生态区的197,000个LiDAR配对瓦片上训练，并在2,530个预留瓦片上与八个基线方法进行评估，Anchor仅使用免费卫星影像即实现了2.83米的MAE……
tldr: 该论文提出锚定残差流方法，仅利用免费的10米Sentinel-2影像通过确定性回归锚点与残差条件流匹配相结合，合成0.5米分辨率的冠层高度模型，在无需昂贵机载LiDAR的情况下达到2.83米MAE。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Anchored Residual Flow (AR-flow), which synthesizes 0.5 m canopy height models solely from free 10 m Sentinel-2 imagery by combining a deterministic regression anchor with residual-based conditional flow matching, achieving 2.83 m MAE without costly airborne LiDAR.
